conditions.today: 6 AM—Up and at 'em, Jackson! Don't be dissuaded by the soggy situation down in the valley. Because April continues its winter assault on Rendezvous Mountain, helping to boost your face-shot tally. 3 new inches have already been slathered across the upper elevations, and heavy snowfall is expected to continue during the early hours. Precipitation will wane this afternoon with the chance of a few stray sunbeams piercing the cloudcover. Morning temperatures will hover in the mid-20s at the summit and the upper 30s in Teton Village before dipping slightly. Gusty southwest winds will be on the increase as the weather pulls out of the area, eventually blasting in the 15-40 mph range. Let the aerial tram take you on a magical trip. But beware; addiction to an alpine dopamine drip is the true cost of membership. -Lege
conditions.yesterday: 6 AM—Climb out of that bed, jump into your favorite goof-off gear, and get out here. I understand that it's April 1st and you might think I'm fooling, but the flanks of Rendezvous Mountain have had an overnight 4" retooling. If you think that's a spoof, come gather your own proof. The vibe will be fun, yet odd and moody as quiet, cloud-covered skies produce the possibility for passing showers through the day. High temperatures will hover in the mid- to upper 20s at the summit as the village rises towards the 50-degree mark. Generally light winds from the west-southwest will be blowing in the 5 to 20 mph neighborhood. Whether you're wet behind the ears or certified old-school, it's always fun to play the fool. Today is the perfect day for practical jokes and comical gestures, so join in the jubilation with all the other big-mountain jesters. -Lege

morningBrief.body: The mountain got a nice 3" boost overnight. Conditions are improved.
